 Karkatshringi – Pistacia integerrima – 96 g 
 Amla – Emblica officinalis – 96 g 
 Trikatu – Ginger (Zingiber officinale), Pepper (Piper nigrum), Long pepper (Piper longum) – 96 g each

 Cow ghee – 192 g

 Sugar – 768 g 
 Jatipushpa – Jasminum sambac – used for the purpose of fragrance. 

 Boiled again to make a semi solid consistency mass to make tablets. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Shiva Gutika (Vati) is a famous Ayurvedic medicine. It is meant to manage the variety of diseases like liver and spleen disorders, epilepsy, ascites, hiccup, rhinitis, bronchitis, cough, anemia, cardiac diseases, vomiting, skin diseases, gout and arthritis. This vati is very good remedy to manage the liver and spleen disorders. It helps to resolve the abnormal fluid, accumulation of fluid in the abdominal (peritoneal) cavity in the problem of ascites. This medicine works well to manage the psychotic disorders that results in abnormal thinking and perceptions. It is also a good herbal medicine to manage the symptoms associated with epilepsy like seizures, temporary confusion, fainting etc. Natural ingredients used in this medicine are packed with the anti-allergic properties that is good in the problem of bronchitis, rhinitis etc. Beside of all this, anti-inflammatory action of this medicine is also helpful in alleviating the pain in gout, arthritis and other painful conditions.

There are no side effects with this medicine. But it is mandatory to take this medicine under medical supervision. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Shiva Gutika (Vati) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaisajya Ratnavali Rasayan Prakarana 73/151-173 
 Shiva Gutika (Vati) is an effective Ayurvedic medicine. It is used to treat the variety of diseases like respiratory conditions, liver and spleen disorders, neuro-psychiatric conditions etc.

 Shilajatu – 768 g 
 Triphala kashaya – A water decoction made of Haritaki, Vibhitaki and Amalaki

 All the above herbs 48 g each, are added with 12.288 liters water and decoction of 3.072 liters is prepared.

 Shiva Gutika (Vati) is a famous Ayurvedic medicine. It is meant to manage the variety of diseases like liver and spleen disorders, epilepsy, ascites, hiccup, rhinitis, bronchitis, cough, anemia, cardiac diseases, vomiting, skin diseases, gout and arthritis. This vati is very good remedy to manage the liver and spleen disorders. It helps to resolve the abnormal fluid, accumulation of fluid in the abdominal (peritoneal) cavity in the problem of ascites. This medicine works well to manage the psychotic disorders that results in abnormal thinking and perceptions.  Rhinitis

 Cough 
 Anemia 
 Cardiac diseases

 Dosage 
 6 gram is divided dose in a day. It is administered with milk, meat soup, pomegranate juice, raisins, appropriate asava and arishta.

 There are no side effects with this medicine. But it is mandatory to take this medicine under medical supervision.
